intent: Login card with "Member login" and "Good to see you" under it. Email and password are both required: the email has to be valid and the password at least 12 characters. The "Sign in" button should only work once both are valid. At the bottom, "New here?" with a "Create an account" button.

checks.message: Email is required
Please enter a valid email address
Password is required
Password must be at least 12 characters long
Please fix errors before signing in

reference_express:
surface("gallery-login-form", sendDataModel=true)
$/email = ""
$/password = ""
root = Card(main_column)
main_column = Column([header, email_field, password_field, login_btn, divider, signup_text])
header = Column([title, subtitle], _, "center")
title = Text("## Member login")
subtitle = Text("Good to see you", "caption")
email_field = TextField("Email", $/email, [?required("Email is required"), ?email("Please enter a valid email address")])
password_field = TextField("Password", $/password, "obscured", [?required("Password is required"), ?length(12, _, "Password must be at least 12 characters long")])
login_btn_text = Text("Sign in")
login_btn = Button(login_btn_text, _, Event("login", {email: $/email}), ?and([email($/email), length($/password, 12)], "Please fix errors before signing in"))
divider = Divider()
signup_text = Row([no_account, signup_link], "center")
no_account = Text("New here?", "caption")
signup_link_text = Text("Create an account")
signup_link = Button(signup_link_text, _, Event("signup", {}))

intent: A "Stock on hand" card listing Flour (2), Sugar (1), each line as the name, ": ", then the quantity.
reference_express:
surface("gallery-child-list-template", sendDataModel=true)
$/items = [{name: "Flour", quantity: 2}, {name: "Sugar", quantity: 1}]
root = Card(main_column)
main_column = Column([title_text, item_list], _, "stretch")
title_text = Text("### Stock on hand")
item_list = List(_template($/items, item_row))
item_row = Row([item_name, qty_label, item_qty])
item_name = Text($name)
qty_label = Text(": ")
item_qty = Text($quantity)
